identity: Server-established organization tenant and active actor; no caller identity fields.
installation_id: Opaque UUID; scope is tenant plus actor, never a bearer credential.
expiry: expires_at <= database clock is expired and must never be claimed by transport. Expiry requires no background write.
replacement: Changed endpoint, keys, expiry or VAPID generation revokes the old version and creates a new generation; unchanged active refresh retains generation.
receipt_semantics: Idempotent historical action receipt, not a current eligibility read. Exact replay must not resurrect revoked or expired versions.
configuration: Only WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY and WEB_PUSH_KEY_GENERATION are read. Missing or malformed config refuses registration with feature_unavailable. No key generation.
preferences: Registration and revocation never change device_opt_in or quiet hours. Existing notification preferences remain authoritative.
transport: No endpoint fetch or push delivery. Later transport must recheck tenant, actor, revoked_at, expires_at, current key generation and current preferences before claiming.
